notes.title: Hot & Lewd: Miami is gearing up to release! 🌴
notes.content:
It's time to test yourself - our protagonist is a rebellious police academy graduate, who decides that parties and racing are much better perspectives than boring patrolling and paperwork. As the atmospheric Miami days unfold, you'll discover an adrenaline-fueled adult narrative full of hot 18+ scenery and engaging twists. Nothing lasts forever, and after getting caught up racing, he's now obliged to work as a police detective - fortunately or not, with a hot female partner who's the complete opposite of him. Opposites attract though, right? Don't forget, your decisions matter - will you jump into crime-solving and leave your past behind? You can find out for yourself this Saturday - pick one of the two suggested cases, be careful with your choices and see where it's all going! Miami's nightlife may be fun, but it's not that easy, especially when you're on duty. 

Get on the case on time, detective - early bird catches! 😉
